kind: mid-work adversarial checkpoint, own findings under test

ownFindingsUnderTest.claim: The SmartCity export emits vector text, so the raster reasoning is wrong.
ownFindingsUnderTest.attackedBy: If html2canvas is bundled, something might call it on a path I did not open. Searched for every reachable entry to the raster path rather than for the library.
ownFindingsUnderTest.outcome: Claim holds. `.html(` 0 occurrences and `API.html` 0 occurrences across 5,578,225 bytes; all 6 `addImage(` sites read individually and every one is inside html2canvas cache, the jsPDF html plugin, or canvg; all 7 `new vn(` windows plus the 8 dynamic-import generators show 0 `addImage` and 0 `toDataURL`.
ownFindingsUnderTest.residualRisk: A raster path could exist in a lazily-loaded chunk outside index-kGj7uMs4.js. Not checked. The bundle is a single module graph entry and the app PDF generators are all inside it, so the risk is low but it is not zero and is stated rather than assumed away.

ownFindingsUnderTest.claim: jsPDF cannot be configured to emit a tagged PDF.
ownFindingsUnderTest.attackedBy: Absence of a string is weak evidence unless the writer must emit that string. Read jsPDF's own putCatalog rather than relying on the grep.
ownFindingsUnderTest.outcome: Claim holds and is now positive rather than negative: putCatalog writes /Type /Catalog, /Pages, /OpenAction, /PageLayout and optionally /PageMode, then closes the dictionary. A tagged PDF must carry the literals /StructTreeRoot and /MarkInfo; both occur 0 times in the bundle.

ownFindingsUnderTest.claim: The three new repos emit no documents.
ownFindingsUnderTest.attackedBy: Repo greps are code-done, not customer-done (DEV_PROCESS 4.4). Re-measured against the served bundles instead.
ownFindingsUnderTest.outcome: Claim holds on the serving surfaces. Dashboards /app.js 44,233 bytes, Smart Files 24,929, Plan Review 33,987; zero hits for every generation token. The single .pdf hit in Smart Files is a filename-extension classifier.

ownFindingsUnderTest.claim: The site-plan PDF comes from SmartSite via hauska-engine.
ownFindingsUnderTest.attackedBy: A pdf-lib producer string plus a plausible repo is a guess. Required an independent chain.
ownFindingsUnderTest.outcome: Claim holds on four independent links: the filename shape is generated by filenameFor in hauska-map, the honesty line matches the extracted page-1 text verbatim, the SP- sheet id matches render.ts:1152, and the served SmartSite bundle contains pe-site-plan-export and _site_plan.pdf while containing zero client PDF libraries.

ownFindingsUnderTest.claim: Chromium print-to-PDF is the right generator.
ownFindingsUnderTest.attackedBy: This is the finding most at risk of being talked into. Required a measured artifact rather than a claim about Chromium, and required the weakness to be measured too.
ownFindingsUnderTest.outcome: Claim holds with a stated limit. Four in-house PDFs carry the full property set. The same measurement shows /NonStruct 50 against /P 4 and /H2 3, which is the limit: Chromium tags what the HTML says. The limit is written into the recommendation rather than omitted.
